entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: By its judgment, dated 09.04.2009, 1st respondent/accused was found not guilty of the offences punishable under Sections 420 and 506 I.P.C and was acquitted of the charges leveled of him.
Aggrieved by the same, the defacto complainant preferred the present criminal appeal.
2. Today when the appeal is taken up, it is brought to the notice of this Court that the notice sent to the accused remained SRK, J unserved, and he died on 21.02.2017.
A report of the Station House Officer concerned, along with copy of Death Certificate of 1st respondent/accused is forwarded by the learned II Additional Junior Civil Judge, Tenali.
